overview: Success Screen presents a completed flow and a clear next step.

positive.title: Positive
positive.text: Use the positive status after a successful completion.

neutral.title: Neutral
neutral.text: Use the neutral status when the result is confirmed but not positive or negative.

negative.title: Negative
negative.text: Use the negative status when the completed flow did not succeed.

api.intro: SuccessScreen is a terminal view for a completed flow.
api.status: Status color and Tag treatment for the completed flow.
api.title: Required title shown in the status header.
api.children: Content rendered inside the Details area.
api.showTopBar: Shows the mobile Top Bar and its close control.
api.closeButtonAriaLabel: Accessible label for the close button. Defaults to 'Fechar'.
api.onClose: Called when the mobile close control is activated.
api.className: Additional class name applied to the root element.

platforms.text: The same example in each library.

tokens.intro: The table below lists the Ocean tokens used by SuccessScreen.

topBar.title: Mobile Top Bar
topBar.text: Show the close control on mobile layouts.

rules: Use SuccessScreen for a completed flow.
Use a concise title and keep supporting content relevant.
Actions render on desktop only; mobile layouts omit them.
The mobile Top Bar is optional and closes through `onClose`.
Use the neutral or negative status Tag icon when replacing its default icon.
feedback: Share component feedback through the Ocean Design System team.
